message:
The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and my family quickly jumped into action. I dug out our trusty flashlights and power banks, while the kids were busy texting in our family group chat about their favorite snacks to munch on during the outage. It turned into a mini scavenger hunt for the best treats, and we ended up laughing about how much we could find without power. 

It was a reminder that even in the dark, staying connected with a little humor (and some snacks!) can brighten the mood. How do you keep the family entertained during a power outage? 🕯️
